name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
summary: Dendrite asks you to return after receiving the Great Cat Spirit’s blessing. He senses a new cunning and ferocity in you, and says you can now learn to call upon the cat’s spirit.

sections.title: Return to Dendrite
sections.body: After the Great Cat Spirit’s blessing, Dendrite asks you to return to him. When you arrive, he gestures above you and senses the cat’s cunning and ferocity in your eyes. He says you now understand the stealth and speed needed to take on this nature.

faq.answer: Return to Dendrite and speak with him.
You have received the blessing of the Great Cat Spirit.

faq.q: What does Dendrite sense in me?
faq.answer: Dendrite senses the cat’s cunning and ferocity in you, along with an understanding of its stealth and speed.
Dendrite says you can now learn to focus your cunning and call upon the cat’s spirit.
